# Crontinel docs

> Documentation for Crontinel, monitoring for cron jobs, queues, workers, and background tasks.

## Start

- [Introduction](https://docs.crontinel.com/introduction/): What Crontinel monitors and how it differs from HTTP pings
- [Quick Start](https://docs.crontinel.com/quick-start/): Shortest path to a monitored app
- [Installation](https://docs.crontinel.com/installation/): Install the package for your stack
